opportunities.idea: Several independent seekers pursuing the same legendary goal, so the player is not uniquely chosen.

basis_refs.q: I am going to seek the WELL AT THE WORLD'S END, and to find it and live, or to find it not, and die

ledger.summary: At dawn the maiden of Bourton Abbas arrives at the crossroads, having followed Ralph; she is going to seek the Well at the World's End. She refuses his company because she senses he has changed since yesterday. She names the roads, says she has heard the Fellowship of the Dry Tree dwells at Hampton, and that the way to the Well is by the Dry Tree, so she rides east toward Hampton.
ledger.geography_notes: The crossroads has four ways: the road from Bourton Abbas (the way she came), the south road to the Burg of the Four Friths, the west road back toward the peopled parts, and the east road to Hampton under Scaur.
open_questions: Is the Fellowship of the Dry Tree connected to the Dry Tree of the Well legend beyond the name?
